answer: My answer to sybils is Certified professional jockey licence with jockey club attestation — a licence the club renews after race audits — which makes the forge of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Scale stops helping the attacker here. Ten clones need ten separate proofs, each with its own a licence the club renews after race audits, and the copper grows linearly while the reward per clone stays flat. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the horizon of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
